narrative.overview: Orrery's pages read like a mid-century planetarium programme printed in two inks on cool uncoated stock. Ultramarine owns whole fields (booking, membership, the footer and the dome itself). Sodium amber is the second ink. It never decorates; it marks the one thing that is live, chosen or held. Where amber lands on ultramarine (held seats on the dome plan), the two inks overprint (multiply), the way a press would print them. Everything is set in one variable grotesk, Archivo, and hierarchy comes from width, weight and size alone. Information is ruled, not boxed. The signature object is the dome plan.
keyCharacteristics: Two inks on cool stock; no third hue
Halftone dot screens as the only texture
Perforated ticket edges on confirmations and dates

rules.name: The Active Ink Rule
rules.body: Amber marks only what is live, selected or held, plus the one primary action per view. If nothing is active, there is no amber.

rules.name: The Overprint Rule
rules.body: Overprint is spent only on amber that is already earned: a held seat carries a slightly misregistered amber ring printed mix-blend-mode: multiply into the ultramarine, so it reads as two inks meeting. Never overprint decoration or headlines.

rules.name: The Tinted Secondary Rule
rules.body: Secondary text takes its hue from the ink of its field (ink-soft on stock, on-ink-soft on blue). Never neutral grey.

rules.name: The Width Is Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Change width before you change family. A second display face is never added.

rules.name: The Flat Press Rule
rules.body: Nothing printed casts a shadow at rest.

dos: Do let ultramarine own whole sections; alternate stock and ink fields down the page.
Do set times, prices and dates as wide black numerals.
Do rule lists with a 2px ink top rule and 1px hairlines.
Do use halftone dots (radial-gradient, about 7px pitch) as the only texture.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion for the sky rotation, presenter pulse, drawer and accordion.
donts: Don't add a third hue or gradients; amber and ultramarine are the only inks.
Don't use amber as decoration on inactive elements.
Don't put content in rounded shadowed cards; rule it instead.
Don't add a second typeface; change Archivo's width instead.
Don't put kicker labels above headings.
